subject: Closer concierge: trial extension + token top-up approval
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@synthware.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot close — proposed concierge top-up + 2-week extension

Hi Samantha,

Great conversation earlier — and thanks again for walking through the integration feedback. SynthWare is one of the clearest fit examples we've seen for the Dedicated offering, and we want to make it frictionless to get you to a production pilot.

To help unblock procurement and give you runway for the final integration items, we can offer the following one-time close package:
- 14 day trial extension (no charge)
- 20k token top-up credited to the pilot (equivalent to ~60k free inference tokens; reflected as a usage credit)

This is conditional on a signed PO referencing the pilot SOW (no changes to standard MSA). I've attached an updated proposal that shows the credit math and the proposed PO language. If that looks good, Ben / I can route the approval and send a DocuSign for the small addendum.

Quick asks: can you confirm the PO contact and whether procurement needs any additional evidence (SOC 2, data location)? We can fast-track SOC 2 evidence via the security packet if you need it.

Attaching: synthware-proposal-v3.pdf

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129

From: Samantha Li <samantha@synthware.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gordon Price <gordon.price@synthware.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot close — proposed concierge top-up + 2-week extension

Jordan — thanks. This looks promising and helps our timeline. A couple of items from procurement:

- We need a simple PO that references the pilot SOW and the credit line.
- Can you confirm data residency (we are US-only) and provide the SOC 2 report or attestation?
- Legal asked if the top-up can be limited to the pilot project ID (so credits don't cascade to other orgs).

If you can get the PO and SOC2 packet across, I'll route to Gordon (cc'd) who will sign the PO if the terms are the same as the SOW. We aim to get this back by Monday.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Head of Integrations | SynthWare
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot close — proposed concierge top-up + 2-week extension

Jordan / Marissa — quick internal:

I'm fine approving the requested package (14-day extension + 20k token credit) against DEAL-8792. We should add a clause that ties the credit to the SynthWare pilot account ID (prevent bleed). Finance wants the credit logged as a one-time usage credit (not a recurring discount).

Suggested next steps (internal):
1) Jordan: prepare a one-page PO stub that references the SOW and notes the 20k credit + 14 day extension.
2) Marissa: if legal needs to sign an addendum, we can push a simple DocuSign — but prefer to keep it a PO + SOW reference to keep turnaround fast.
3) Ben: I'll authorize the credit in the billing system once PO is received.

If anyone needs explicit approval chain, I can escalate to Revenue Ops, but I don't think it's necessary for this size.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@synthware.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot close — proposed concierge top-up + 2-week extension

Samantha — good news, we can proceed. Approved: 14-day extension + 20k token top-up tied explicitly to the SynthWare pilot account ID. Conditions: signed PO referencing the existing SOW and the attached credit approval form.

Actions I've taken:
- Attached credit-approval-form.pdf (fillable).
- Created a DocuSign envelope ready for signature if you'd prefer an electronic flow: https://app.redwood.ai/ds/DEAL-8792-sign
- Attached SOC 2 evidence link in the related links above; data residency confirmed US-only in our control plane (see security packet on the drive).

If you can send the PO to finance@redwood.ai or sign the DocuSign by EOD Monday, we'll push the credit live immediately and extend the pilot window by 14 days from the original end date.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Li <samantha@synthware.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gordon Price <gordon.price@synthware.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot close — proposed concierge top-up + 2-week extension

Thanks Jordan — we'll route the PO today and Gordon will review the DocuSign if it's easier. PO contact is procurement@synthware.ai (attn: Gordon Price).

I appreciate the quick turn. I'll confirm once it's sent.

— Samantha
